text:
emily: quick one — opened a tiny PR to fix 2 broken docs links and update the python SDK snippet that no longer matches the new client API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/442

docs-bot: docs-preview job failed (parser error). Logs: `Unexpected token at line 42` — rerun with `/rerun-job docs-preview` or push a small whitespace change to trigger CI.

jason: thanks for flagging. i can take the SDK example review now. will check the client import + auth bit.

maria: i can eyeball the link targets and the migration note. small nit: include the old->new param mapping.

emily: ideal is to merge during today's quick doc sync window (4–5pm PT). if preview keeps flaking we can do a manual QA and ship a link-only hotfix.

liam: heads-up — i'm in the sync until 4:10. if you need a reviewer after that, @alex is free to quick-merge.

alex: yep i can do quick pass and merge once both of you sign off. prefer to avoid rebases.

jason: found one more thing in the snippet — the `client.generate` call should set `temperature=0.0` for the sample. left a comment.

maria: link checks look good aside from one permalink to the migration guide that 404s. replaced with the archived anchor. pushed suggestion.

emily: thanks — @jason @maria want to swap review ownership? if either of you is blocked for timing i can reassign.

jason: i'm good to finish, should be done in 20m.

maria: done reviewing; left one tiny wording suggestion. looks fine to merge once tests pass. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: Preview succeeded on rerun (job #774). URL: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/442 — visual check recommended.

alex: running a quick visual QA now.

alex: visual QA ✅ — links load, SDK sample renders correctly. merging once CI green.

emily: merged — thanks everyone. tagging for rotation: jason -> primary reviewer today, maria -> secondary. please update the review rota doc if this changes coverage.

liam: noted. i'll update the rota sheet after stand.

emily: follow-up: if preview flakiness becomes a pattern we should open a small infra issue to get the parser errors triaged. for now, thanks for the fast turnaround.
